shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin struggles under $80K; long-term holders selling, ETFs outflow.
US PPI inflation jumps; Fed hike odds for Sept 16 surge to ~85%.
Ethereum sees strong inflows to ETFs, outperforming Bitcoin recently.
BRICS nations push to link CBDCs for cross-border digital payments.
US CLARITY Act for crypto regulation heads to Senate vote next week.
